semantics: RC24 retains RC19 transient recovery clients, RC18 RECOVERY_SAFE RAM U-Boot FIPs, RC21 content-gated Stage 6/handoff behavior, RC23 timestamp+backup MAC identity, and RC24 persistent interactive navigation with SAFETY-LATCH. TFTP remains the first recommended operator transport. The RC22 bad-block UART restore mapper is not full-HW-validated: real MF booted stock main image/kernel after restore but data UBIFS recovery failed and watchdog rebooted.

CAP_FULL_BACKUP.evidence: established MD backend; per-device validation still required

CAP_BOOTLOADER_REPLACE.evidence: AN7581 tcboot research is not integrated into the production installer

CAP_UART_RECOVERY.evidence: Historical MD BootROM/XMODEM path exists, but RC17fix5 exposed an unsafe ordinary U-Boot autoboot path that could run ubi_format=mtd erase ubi before prompt capture. RC18 replaces BL33 with RECOVERY_SAFE and blocks NAND capability until SAFE marker + nonce proof; exact RC18 FIP is not yet hardware-confirmed.

CAP_MF_TRANSITION_BOOT.evidence: MD uses the established hardware-confirmed MD transition path

CAP_FULL_BACKUP.evidence: rc12fix live MF-A capture: mtd0..mtd16, exact gzip stream SHA256 router==PC, restore-validator PASS, BACKUP_HW_VALIDATED
CAP_FULL_BACKUP.other_variants: MF-A-MIRROR/MF-B/MF-B-MIRROR remain live-gated and require their own end-to-end capture for HW-confirmed status

CAP_RAM_OPENWRT.evidence: rc14fix6 hardware run booted Linux 6.18.41 transition on Nokia XG-040G-MF (UBI).

CAP_UBI_FORMAT.evidence: rc14fix6 hardware run formatted and attached the 0xffe0000 UBI region successfully; 2047 good PEBs, 0 bad PEBs.

CAP_UBI_VOLUME_WRITE.evidence: rc14fix6 hardware run created canonical volumes, wrote bosa/ri/FIP/fallback FIT and passed readback SHA256 before BL2.

CAP_BOOTLOADER_REPLACE.evidence: RC16 hardware run: pinned BL2 provenance rechecked immediately before [7/8], complete BL2 partition written LAST, [8/8] completion reached; production keeps BL2 read-only.

CAP_PERMANENT_INSTALL.evidence: RC16 hardware run: stock MF-A -> transition -> [1/8]..[8/8] -> production sysupgrade successful -> production nokia,xg-040g-mf-ubi with canonical UBI volumes and LuCI.

CAP_UART_RECOVERY.evidence: RC16 confirmed the base EVB preloader/FIP and full stock restore. RC18 keeps the preloader but ships a RECOVERY_SAFE-derived FIP with persistent env neutralized and bootdelay=-1; exact RC18 FIP requires hardware regression.

CAP_MF_TRANSITION_BOOT.evidence: RC16 hardware run confirmed transition boot and complete autonomous all-in-UBI migration through [8/8].

rc22_bad_block_restore.bad_block_policy: physical-span restore for known bad PEBs only in stock UBI-backed mutable region; raw-critical bad blocks fail closed
rc22_bad_block_restore.evidence: Real MF write/readback completed; stock main image/kernel booted; data UBIFS failed ubifs_recover_master_node and watchdog rebooted. Full stock restore is not HW PASS.

rc23_timestamp_and_backup_identity.console_timestamps: absolute local YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS on master.py operator lines/prompts
rc23_timestamp_and_backup_identity.backup_identity: DEVICE_MAC.txt on live-stock TFTP and USB backups; primary eth0 when available; SHA256-covered
